steps: Escalate any case to the HR Director (Nicole Ashford) under the following circumstances:
Any P1 issue.
Any case unresolved for more than 10 business days.
Any legal threat, reference to an attorney, or mention of a regulatory complaint.
Any situation involving potential harm to an employee or to the university.
Any media inquiry related to HR matters.
For legal threats: Do NOT reply to the email.
Post to #hr-escalations: LEGAL THREAT: [Employee Name], [Subject Line] – do not reply.
Forward to hr-escalations@crestwood.edu.
Dr. Whitfield and Nicole Ashford will handle all further communication.
For media inquiries: Do NOT reply.
Forward to the university's Office of Communications at communications@crestwood.edu and to hr-escalations@crestwood.edu.
must_not: For legal threats: Do NOT reply to the email.
For media inquiries: Do NOT reply.

priority.name: Priority Matrix
levels: P1 – Urgent | Compliance deadline within 24 hours; legal or safety issue; employee locked out of pay or benefits. | I-9 deadline expiring today; COBRA 14-day notice window closing; employee reports workplace safety threat. | Same business day

P2 – High | Compliance deadline within 3 business days; formal complaint; FMLA eligibility determination; PIP-related termination in progress. | I-9 due within 3 days; FMLA medical certification deadline; formal written complaint requesting escalation. | 1 business day

P3 – Standard | Routine processing with no imminent deadline; standard onboarding/offboarding; evaluation scheduling; PTO balance inquiries. | New hire onboarding (start date > 3 days away); annual evaluation scheduling; standard resignation processing. | 3 business days

P4 – Low | General inquiries; employment verification; policy questions; document requests. | Employee asking about PTO policy; request for copy of offer letter; general benefits question answered by handbook. | 5 business days

Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

General Inquiries has no row in the Jira naming table. Does a general inquiry get a Jira ticket, and if yes with which prefix, assignee and date?

Steps 3 and 4 of triage say to take no further action for employee relations and payroll requests, but the naming table has ER and BENEFITS rows. Does the coordinator create a Jira ticket in these two cases?
The Benefits & Payroll row says "Calvin Briggs / Patricia Huang". Which requests go to each person?

Benefits changes, qualifying life events, employment verifications, policy questions and form requests have no procedure section. Are they handled by Step 7 of triage in some way, or escalated as not covered with [OUT OF SCOPE]?
A complaint that also mentions an attorney matches both triage Step 3 (forward to m.voss@crestwood.edu, reply using Template 2) and Section 16 (do NOT reply). Which one wins?

Section 16 says to escalate to the HR Director but names a channel and a format only for legal threats and media inquiries. How is a P1 issue or a case older than 10 business days escalated: a post to #hr-escalations, an email, or both?
Which Slack channel takes the [OUT OF SCOPE] notification? The text does not name one.
The default subject starts with [Template Name]. What is the subject of a new email that uses no template, such as a follow-up to the hiring manager or an email to d.okonkwo@crestwood.edu?

Some templates have two names, for example Template 4 "New Hire Welcome" and "Welcome Email", Template 9 "Benefits Final Notice (Day 25)" and "Final Benefits Notice", Template 19 "ADA Accommodation Request Acknowledged" and "ADA Request Acknowledged", Templates 8, 24, 25 and 26 with and without the part in brackets, Template 23 with and without "Annual". Which name goes in the subject line?

Must every Jira comment use the default comment format with one of the listed Actions, including "No COBRA required – employee not enrolled in health benefits." and the new information added under triage Step 5?

The description table adds Priority, Deadline and Status when a section involves a deadline or tells you to assign a priority, but no section says to assign a priority. Which sections count, and what is the value of Status?
